environment.description: Same Rails application deployed inside a gVisor (runsc) container with a custom OCI runtime spec. The container's rootfs is assembled via a read-only overlay mount with a single writable tmpfs layer at /app/public/uploads (size-limited to 50MB, noexec,nosuid,nodev mount options). The process runs under a seccomp-bpf profile that denies execve/execveat syscalls (SCMP_ACT_ERRNO with EPERM) except for the initial ruby interpreter PID. The container's mount namespace provides no access to /etc/passwd, /etc/shadow, /proc/self/environ, or any host paths — the rootfs contains only the minimal Ruby runtime, application code, and gem dependencies. Network egress is restricted via a Cilium L3/L4 policy allowing only TCP port 5432 (PostgreSQL) to a specific ClusterIP. The gVisor sentry intercepts all filesystem operations, and path traversal beyond the overlay boundary returns ENOENT regardless of constructed path.

config.seccomp_profile: custom profile: SCMP_ACT_ERRNO on execve(59), execveat(322); applied post-init via OCI hooks
config.mount_namespace: isolated, no /proc/self/environ, no host bind mounts
config.network_policy: Cilium CiliumNetworkPolicy egress allow TCP:5432 to 10.96.42.15/32 only
config.capabilities: drop ALL, no cap_sys_admin, no cap_dac_override
